generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a prickly shrub of upright stems with pinnate leaves of toothed leaflets and large single pink flowers, followed by round red hips. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 1.5 m tall at 12 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: mid-green leaflets; pink flowers; reddish-brown stems. Fruit (plant roadmap P4), as in mid-July: round hips about 2 cm across with the sepals still on, green turning red. Its year (appearance.organs.bloom.season) is authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands: pink roses in May to July; hips green, red from August, hanging through the winter. The forest's packages show day 196 (mid-July) until the phenology of plant roadmap P5 sets the day from the date and the local climate.
